Definition: Sokoh or Soko, the name of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Shocho or Shochoh or Sochoh or Shoco or Socoh = "bushy"; 1) a town in the lowlands of Judah; 2) a town in the mountain district of Judah
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
